_comment: Preconfigured playlists, installed automatically the first time the app runs. Each one can list exact track keys under 'tracks' and/or 'rules' that pull matching songs in automatically: a folder name anywhere in the file's path, an artist, an album, or an exact title. After installation they behave like any other playlist on the watch: rename, add, remove, delete. Give each playlist a new 'id' when you add one, so it gets installed on the next launch.
